claim: Patchline ships a program-synthesis engine that repairs an entire migration suite to satisfy a global invariant set. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the global invariant claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make suite-program-synthesis-gate`.
